biological.citation: Rajakumari et al. 2013 - EBF2 determines and maintains brown adipocyte identity (PMID: 23499423)
biological.summary: EBF2 is a transcription factor selectively expressed in brown relative to white adipocytes. It recruits Pparγ to brown-selective binding sites and reprograms myoblasts and white preadipose cells to a brown fat fate. Ebf2-deficient mice lose brown-specific characteristics and thermogenic capacity.

biological.citation: Shapira et al. 2017 - EBF2 transcriptionally regulates brown adipogenesis via the histone reader DPF3 and the BAF chromatin remodeling complex (PMID: 28428261)
biological.summary: EBF2 binds lineage-specific enhancers in BAT by ChIP-seq. It physically interacts with BRG1 and the BAF complex. Dpf3 is a direct EBF2 target and a brown fat-selective BAF component, and loss of DPF3 reduces chromatin accessibility at EBF2-bound enhancers.

biological.citation: Zhao et al. 2014 - A long noncoding RNA transcriptional regulatory circuit drives thermogenic adipocyte differentiation (PMID: 25002143)
biological.summary: The lncRNA Blnc1 forms a ribonucleoprotein complex with EBF2 to stimulate the thermogenic gene program. Blnc1 is itself an EBF2 target, forming a feedforward loop that drives thermogenic adipogenesis.

biological.citation: Stine et al. 2016 - EBF2 promotes the recruitment of beige adipocytes in white adipose tissue (PMID: 26844207)
biological.summary: Ebf2 knockout mice and primary cultures fail to induce UCP1 or a thermogenic program after adrenergic stimulation. Transgenic EBF2 overexpression in adipose tissue drives beige adipocyte development, even at thermoneutrality. It also increases WAT mitochondrial function and protects against high-fat diet-induced weight gain.

biological.citation: Dynamic Expression and New Functions of Early B Cell Factor 2 in Cerebellar Development (PMID: 31273610)
biological.summary: Genetic fate mapping shows Ebf2 mRNA is initially present in all Purkinje cell progenitors. It is also activated in an early-born subset of anterior-lobe granule cell precursors and is expressed prenatally in projection neurons of all cerebellar nuclei. Ebf2 null mice have severely hypocellular fastigial nuclei.

biological.citation: An ancient role for collier/Olf/Ebf (COE)-type transcription factors in axial motor neuron development (PMID: 30658714)
biological.summary: mEbf2 is expressed in medial motor column spinal motor neurons, and Ebf2 knockout mice show defective differentiation of a subset of these neurons. Transgenic mouse Ebf2 rescues axial motor neuron differentiation and locomotor defects in C. elegans unc-3 mutants, indicating functional conservation.

biological.citation: A genome-wide association study identifies four novel susceptibility loci underlying inguinal hernia (PMID: 26686553)
biological.summary: The EBF2 locus is one of four novel inguinal hernia susceptibility loci, alongside EFEMP1, WT1 and ADAMTS6. EBF2 expression was observed in mouse connective tissue.
biological.sample_size: 72,805 discovery subjects (5,295 cases, 67,510 controls); 92,444 replication subjects (9,701 cases, 82,743 controls)
biological.significance: genome-wide significant, replicated in independent cohort

biological.citation: Deubiquitinating enzyme USP2 regulates brown adipose tissue thermogenesis via controlling EBF2 stabilization (PMID: 40189098)
biological.summary: Proteome-wide analysis identified EBF2 as a substrate of the deubiquitinase USP2. USP2 stabilizes EBF2 and mediates BAT thermogenic function. Usp2 knockdown or inhibition impairs thermogenesis, while Usp2 overexpression protects against diet-induced obesity.

biological.citation: SOX4 facilitates brown fat development and maintenance through EBF2-mediated thermogenic gene program in mice (PMID: 39402212)
biological.summary: SOX4 acts upstream of EBF2 and activates EBF2 transcription, which determines brown fat fate. PKA phosphorylation of SOX4 at S235 promotes its nuclear translocation and EBF2 transcription. SOX4 also cooperates with EBF2 to drive thermogenic gene expression.

biological.citation: Elevated EBF2 in mouse but not pig drives the progressive brown fat lineage specification via chromatin activation (PMID: 39736442)
biological.summary: EBF2 interacts with CBP/P300 to deposit H3K27ac and activate chromatin at BAT-associated genes, driving brown fat specification and diverting cells from the muscle lineage. Both mouse and pig EBF2 stimulate adipogenesis in multipotent mesodermal stem cells. Pig EBF2 expression is depleted during the critical specification window, which explains the absence of porcine BAT.
